The 9th Crunchyroll Anime Awards will be held at the Grand Prince Hotel New Takanawa in Tokyo, Japan. It will be hosted by Sally Amaki and Jon Kabira, who previously hosted the 7th and 8th Crunchyroll Anime Awards
